schinese.name: DEFEAT_OLD_ONES_ARMY_TIER3

schinese.description: Obtain the Zenith, the culmination of a journey forged into the ultimate sword.
schinese.name: GET_ZENITH

schinese.description: Obtain the Terraspark Boots, forged from the finest boots of fire and ice.
schinese.name: GET_TERRASPARK_BOOTS

schinese.description: Fly a kite on a windy day.
schinese.name: FLY_A_KITE_ON_A_WINDY_DAY

schinese.description: Enter a misty graveyard filled with the surly dead.
schinese.name: FOUND_GRAVEYARD

schinese.description: Drop a lure in a pool of lava for a pre-fried haul!
schinese.name: GO_LAVA_FISHING

schinese.description: Trick a gnome into turning into stone!
schinese.name: TURN_GNOME_TO_STATUE

schinese.description: Meet with a tenant who's as happy as they possibly can be!
schinese.name: TALK_TO_NPC_AT_MAX_HAPPINESS

schinese.description: Deliver headpats to the town pet.
schinese.name: PET_THE_PET

schinese.description: Encounter a fairy.
schinese.name: FIND_A_FAIRY

schinese.description: What you're celebrating doesn't matter, just throw a party already!
schinese.name: THROW_A_PARTY

schinese.description: You were so preoccupied with whether or not you could open the chest that you didn't stop to think if you should.
schinese.name: DIE_TO_DEAD_MANS_CHEST

schinese.description: Defeat Deerclops, the chilly one-eyed monstrosity from a foreign land.
schinese.name: DEFEAT_DEERCLOPS

schinese.description: Obtain Golden Delight, the highest quality meal made from the highest quality . . . ingredients.
schinese.name: GET_GOLDEN_DELIGHT

schinese.description: Delay death from drowning by drinking water. It doesn't make much sense, but you did what you had to do.
schinese.name: DRINK_BOTTLED_WATER_WHILE_DROWNING

schinese.description: Obtain the Cell Phone. You'll never leave home without it again.
schinese.name: GET_CELL_PHONE

schinese.description: Obtain the Ankh Shield, the finest protection from unpleasant maladies and ailments.
schinese.name: GET_ANKH_SHIELD

schinese.description: Invoked the wrath of the God of Torches, and survived long enough to earn its blessing.
schinese.name: GAIN_TORCH_GODS_FAVOR

schinese.description: Some very special seeds can lead to unique and rewarding experiences. Can you find one?
schinese.name: PLAY_ON_A_SPECIAL_SEED

schinese.description: Find all of the Slime Pets and have them move in!
schinese.name: ALL_TOWN_SLIMES

schinese.description: Shimmer an item into another item. What other transmutations can you find?
schinese.name: TRANSMUTE_ITEM

schinese.description: Completely purify all Corruption, Crimson, and Hallow from your world, until the Dryad is satisfied!
schinese.name: PURIFY_ENTIRE_WORLD

schinese.description: Fly a Kwad Racer into outer space.
schinese.name: TO_INFINITY_AND_BEYOND

schinese.description: Catalogue every creature in the world.
schinese.name: BOOK_WORM

schinese.description: Prove your worth against the Moon Lord's worst.
schinese.name: BOULDER_LORD

schinese.description: Defeated the combined form of the 3 mechanical giants.
schinese.name: QUEEN_MACHINE

schinese.description: Take a ride in your final resting place.
schinese.name: ROLLIN_IN_YOUR_GRAVE

schinese.description: Dawn the garb of a vampire and get a sunburn.
schinese.name: FEAR_THE_SUN

schinese.description: Survive the dreaded rain of boulders.
schinese.name: ITS_SHALING_OUTSIDE

schinese.description: Die as a hardcore character and survive to tell the tale.
schinese.name: EXTRA_LIFE

schinese.description: “Accidentally” kill a friend with your tombstone.
schinese.name: GRAVE_MISTAKE

schinese.description: Jam out on a six stringed instrument.
schinese.name: SPICY_LICKS

schinese.description: Find the ultra rare Rod of Discord.
schinese.name: ORGANIZED_CHAOS

schinese.description: Spot the sun on a “cool” day.
schinese.name: ON_FLEEK

schinese.description: Discover a friendly boulder.
schinese.name: FORTUNE_FAVORS_THE_BOULD

schinese.description: Get your villagers fully combat ready.
schinese.name: TRAINING_DAY

schinese.description: Become a Moon Lord impersonator.
schinese.name: MINI_ME

schinese.description: Scare your villagers with a stink bug sword.
schinese.name: TERRARIST

schinese.description: Give any villager a new look.
schinese.name: NEW_DIGS

schinese.description: Embark on a one way trip into outer space.
schinese.name: MY_PEOPLE_NEED_ME

schinese.description: Bring back the original title screen.
schinese.name: GOING_OLDSCHOOL

schinese.description: Craft the final upgrade to the Cell Phone.
schinese.name: SEA_YOU_LATER

schinese.description: Research 50% of all items in Journey Mode.
schinese.name: TRASH_COMPACTOR

schinese.description: Support sustainable logging by planting 100 acorns.
schinese.name: CONSERVATIONIST

schinese.description: Give the Dryad a can of Joja Cola.
schinese.name: INTERDIMENSIONAL_RECYCLING

english.description: [PSO2] Proof of clearing a quest in Multiplayer. Our adventure is just beginning!  We're counting on you for the next quest!
english.displayName: On an Endless Adventure, Once Again!
english.name: CLEAR_AT_MULTI

english.description: [PSO2] Proof of triggering a PSE burst. The rising pillar of light is a sign of benediction! Now the real battle begins!
english.name: PSE_BURST_OCCURRED

english.description: [PSO2] Proof of creating a weapon with a +10 enhancement. The will to never retreat, a spirit that never wavers, and an unbreakable asset.
english.name: GRIND_ITEM_PLUS10

english.description: [PSO2] Proof of triggering a Photon Blast. *Not unlockable in NGS. Release the power that you kindled!
english.name: PHOTON_BLAST_INVOKED

english.description: [PSO2] Proof of entering an Alliance Quarters. Let's all support each other, until it feels natural for you to be right alongside us.
english.name: TEAM_ROOM_ENTERED

english.description: [PSO2] Proof of getting a high score in Trick Darts. Aim your darts at the board over there, and *shunk*!
english.name: HIGH_SCORE_FOR_DARTS

english.description: [PSO2] Proof of killing Vol Dragon. *Restricted to single party areas. May it perish in the fires of the volcano it was dunked in!
english.displayName: Vol Dragon, the Supreme Ruler of Purgatory
english.name: KILL_DRAGON_MAGMA

english.description: [PSO2] Proof of killing Quartz Dragon. *Restricted to single party areas. In its insolence, it personally killed our noble dragons!
english.displayName: Quartz Dragon, Ruler of the Wild Blue Skies
english.name: KILL_DRAGON_CRYSTAL

english.description: [PSO2] Proof of killing Fang Banser. *Restricted to single party areas. "King of Beasts" refers to those who would first sic others on the enemy before themselves.
english.displayName: Fang Banser, Assassin of the Secret Forest
english.name: KILL_PANTHER_A

english.description: [PSO2] Proof of destroying Big Varder. *Restricted to single party areas. As always, big launchers on big warships are the stuff of dreams! Although no idea who made it...
english.name: KILL_BOSS_MECHA_A

english.description: [PSO2] Proof of killing Dark Ragne. *Restricted to single party areas. As far as this immensely spacious universe, are they pests, or are they beneficial insects?
english.displayName: Dark Ragne, Predator of the Abyss
english.name: KILL_SPIDER

english.description: [PSO2] Proof you've changed your Main Class to a Hunter of Level 30 or higher. Yeah, you know Hunters are the best! Don't bother being a Force! They always need to be protected.
english.name: CHANGE_HUNTER

english.description: [PSO2] Proof you've changed your Main Class to a Ranger of Level 30 or higher. Rangers are awesome! Heh heh! Let's make pincushions out of every last little enemy!
english.displayName: Turned Into an Archer Wielding Flames
english.name: CHANGE_RANGER

english.description: [PSO2] Proof you've changed your Main Class to a Force of Level 30 or higher. Yeah, being a Force is the best after all... Being a Hunter is nothing but hot, sweaty work.
english.displayName: Turned Into a Creator of All Things
english.name: CHANGE_FORCE

english.description: [PSO2] Proof you've changed your Main Class to a Fighter of Level 30 or higher. Being a Fighter ain't bad, either! It's a fine choice! Just watch out for Techters!
english.name: CHANGE_FIGHTER

english.description: [PSO2] Proof you've changed your Main Class to a Gunner of Level 30 or higher. Being a Gunner's a nice! Watch enemies dance while you shoot 'em more holes than a honeycomb!
english.displayName: Turned Into a Musketeer Bearing Meteors
english.name: CHANGE_GUNNER

english.description: [PSO2] Proof you've changed your Main Class to a Techter of Level 30 or higher. Being a Techter's great. Fighter is out of the question. They get in the way of the rays we shoot.
english.displayName: Turned Into One Who Controls Domains
english.name: CHANGE_TECHER

english.description: [PSO2] Proof of clearing a quest with Quna. Did you watch me on stage!? ...Huh, you couldn't really see me because of my invisibility power?
english.name: CLEAR_WITH_CUNA

english.description: [PSO2] Proof of killing Falz Hyunal. *Restricted to single party areas. If one who fights humans take a human form, isn't it because human forms are the strongest to take?
english.displayName: Falz Hyunal, the Jet Black Beacon
english.name: KILL_DP_HUMAN

english.description: [PSO2] Proof of killing Chrome Dragon. *Restricted to single party areas. There are no assailants to be found. For here, there are only victims.
english.name: KILL_DRAGON_BERSERK_A

english.description: [PSO2] Proof of having failed at Armor Enhancement. Think about it this way: At least this means you have meseta to burn, right?
english.displayName: That's Amazingly Bad Luck You've Got There
english.name: GRIND_ITEM_FAILED

english.description: [PSO2] Proof of triggering an Troy-type Photon Blast from an extremely enraged Mag. Its Photon Blast is awoken by its intense anger, even while it maintains its calm demeanor...
english.name: PHOTON_BLAST_EP2_INVOKED

english.description: [PSO2] Proof of killing Bar Lodos. *Restricted to single party areas. Placid seas can hardly forge experienced sailors. Every crisis is an opportunity!
english.displayName: Bar Lodos, Conqueror of the Raging Currents
english.name: KILL_MARINE_OARFISH

english.description: [PSO2] Proof you've changed your Main Class to a Braver of Level 30 or higher. Yes, the new class, the Braver! Become a Braver today!
english.displayName: Turned Into a Master of Opportunities
english.name: CHANGE_BRAVER

english.description: [PSO2] Find the hidden Lillipan hiding out in the Casino. "Lin... (they found me)!"
english.name: HIDE_AND_SEEK

english.description: [PSO2] Proof of killing Gigur Gunnegam. *Restricted to single party areas. If a divine punishment awaits him, then let him have it!
english.displayName: Gigur Gunnegam, the Demon of the Frozen Ice
english.name: KILL_MONO_YOROI

english.description: [PSO2] Proof you've changed your Main Class to a Bouncer of Level 30 or higher. Surely it was fate that you'd become a Bouncer! Please, by all means, tell me your orders!
english.name: CHANGE_BOUNCER

english.description: [PSO2] Proof of clearing the EPISODE 4 Story Quest, "The Time of Awakening." Search for worlds yet unseen.
english.name: CLEAR_EP4

english.description: [PSO2] Proof of destroying Train Gidran. *Restricted to single party areas. There's no lying about how scary that was…
english.displayName: Train Gidran, the Phantom Runaway Train
english.name: KILL_TRAIN

english.description: [PSO2] Proof you've changed your Main Class to a Summoner of Level 30 or higher. The Summoner, who can be with their beloved children even on the battlefield, is the most elegant!
english.name: CHANGE_SUMMONER

english.description: [PSO2] Proof of clearing the EPISODE 5 Story Quest, "Seeking the Hand of Salvation." And now, the doorway to a new world shall be opened.
english.name: CLEAR_EP5

english.description: [PSO2] Proof of clearing the EPISODE 1 Story Quest, "An Encounter with Xion." Sooo... what kinds of records can we see from here? I've got a feeling it's going to be really fun!
english.name: CLEAR_OMNIBUS

english.description: [PSO2] Proof you've changed your Main Class to a Hero. Everyone in ARKS is a Hero! Now let's go show the world!
english.name: CHANGE_HERO

english.description: [PSO2] Proof of clearing the EPISODE 6 Story Quest, "Goddess' Prelude". No one is privy to the true ending.
english.name: CLEAR_EP6

english.description: [PSO2] Proof of destroying a luminmech. *Restricted to single party areas. Marvels manipulated by the Photoners.
english.name: KILL_CYPHER

english.description: [PSO2] Proof you've changed your Main Class to Phantom. So you want power? Best seek the power of the "Phantom"…
english.displayName: Turned Into a Phantom Amidst Shadow
english.name: CHANGE_VILLAIN

english.description: [NGS] Proof of causing PSE Bursts in PSO2:NGS. Can you fight your way through?
english.name: PSE_BURST_NGS_OCCURRED

english.description: [NGS] Proof of defeating Nogleth. The beatings won't stop until they apologize.
english.name: KILL_GD_BOX

english.description: [NGS] Proof of defeating Nex Aelio. Bringing peace to Aelio is what ARKS defenders do.
english.name: KILL_GD_DRA

english.description: [NGS] Proof of creating a Multi-weapon in PSO2:NGS. All hail ARKS's multi-purpose innovation!
english.name: GRIND_ITEM_MULTI_WEAPON

english.description: [NGS] Proof of forming a party with other players in PSO2:NGS. Strength through diversity.
english.name: JOIN_PARTY_NGS

english.description: [NGS] Proof of reaching Level 20 with any class in PSO2:NGS. ARKS defenders, reach for the stars!
english.name: CHANGE_NGS_MAIN

english.description: [NGS] Proof of touching down on a Creative Space in PSO2:NGS. Turn tomorrow's creation into life.
english.name: CREATIVE_SPACE_ENTERED

english.description: [NGS] Proof of defeating Herzig. The war against the Starless has only just begun.
english.name: KILL_STL_GIA

english.description: [NGS] Proof of reaching Level 75 with any class in PSO2:NGS. You just keep growing!
english.name: CHANGE_NGS_MAIN_LV75
